# Aesthedes C100/0009, text-based CRT Controller

<!-- $Begin-Autogenerated$ FeaturedPic aes_crtc -->
[![Aesthedes CRT controller card #568](https://www.egueli.com/aesthedes/thumbs/cards/518_AesC100-0009_SN568/IMG_20260220_160208.jpg)](https://www.egueli.com/aesthedes/pics/cards/518_AesC100-0009_SN568/IMG_20260220_160208.jpg)

Aesthedes CRT controller card #568


<!-- $End-Autogenerated$ -->

This card is used to control a monochrome text-based CRT. It is based on the Rockwell R6545 chip.

It interfaces with the CPU in the same crate using addresses in the 0x04ffa0xx range. It uses 32 bytes of addressing space, of which offsets 1 and 3 (and probably also 5 and 7, 9 and 11...) are used to access the registers according to the datasheet.

Which range of 32 bytes is being used by each card, is determined by cutting some traces in the back side of the PCB. This allows a CPU to control multiple such cards in the same bus.

The breakable traces are near the connector, in-between the pads of the two unpopulated 16 pin DIP packages (maybe DIP switches, left out to save costs). The traces connect some of those pad to ground; when broken, they may allow the voltage to be pulled up by the nearby resistor network. 

## Slot 518

SN: 568

Connections:

	A: to left B/W CRT

This card seems to have one broken trace, the 4th out of a group of 6 at the top.
